name: Monsido Tools
description: Integrates the Monsido web-governance (accessibility/quality/SEO) platform into a site.
project_description:
NOTE: this module is now deprecated. Please use the Acquia Optimize module instead.

 All-in-one platform that unifies web governance, quality assurance, and accessibility compliance. Monsido help you optimize your website, quickly and easily.

 Web Accessibility 

Accessibility laws vary by country and sector, so Monsido ensure that your site is validated against the international standard, the WCAG 2.1. Make your website accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities, and achieve global accessibility compliance. Monsido scans your site to find any possible issues that may hinder accessibility, giving you an overview of how your website is doing, as well as recommendations on how to address them.

 SEO 

 Monsido helps you improve your search engine rankings by finding SEO errors and optimization opportunities on every page it scans.

 Content Policies 

 Set content policies and rules so all your content providers follow the same guidelines and be alerted immediately if your content is outdated.
